title: Reduction of anxiety in children with congenital heart disease and their parents prior to sedated cardiovascular MRI using a child-friendly interdisciplinary illustrated information book
summary: The project aims to reduce the fear of children and parents regarding cardiovascular MRI scans under sedation. This will be achieved by providing children with an interdisciplinary, child-friendly information booklet before the MRI scan.

interventions.name: First a patient group of 55 children will initially be observed as a control group. On the day of the invastigation, data will be collected using a questionnaire which could possibly be related to anxiety of children and parents as well as to the use of books.

The intervention group receives during the consultation an interdisciplinary picture book designed for children which they take home with them. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
cardiovascular mRI examination in sedation, consent to participate in the study and children at age between 3 and 10 years
Exclusion criteria:
Refusal to participate in the study, communication problems, psychological and cognition-affecting illnesses, children younger than 3 years and older than 10 years.
